start: Routine editor, routine 'Push A' with 5 exercises

user_sees: Sheet 'Share Push A' with 'Text anyone can read, or a file another MettleUp member can open.'
Rows 'Send as text' and 'Send as a file'
must_not: Another routine's name in the title

user_sees: Sheet closes; the phone's share list opens with the routine as text
must_not: Text missing exercises, sets or reps
The member's body weight or name in the text

start: Workout tab, a folder 'PPL' with 3 routines

steps.action: Share the folder, tap 'Send as a file'
user_sees: The phone's share list with a routine file
must_not: A file holding only the first routine

steps.action: Another MettleUp member opens it with 'Import a routine file'
user_sees: A new folder with the 3 routines
must_not: The routines doubled when opened twice without a question

start: Phone with no app that can take a file

user_sees: Message 'Sharing is not available' — 'This phone has no app to send the file with.'

steps.action: Tap 'Send as text' and the share list errors
user_sees: Message 'Could not share' — 'Something went wrong. Please try again.'
Back on the routine; nothing changed
must_not: An error message for a cancel

user_sees: Only routine names, exercises, sets, reps and rest go out
must_not: Workout history, body weight, photos or the gym in the text or file
